title: QuickShip starts Sunday delivery
text: QuickShip now delivers on Sundays in metro cities.

title: QuickShip delivery days
text: We deliver Monday to Sunday. Sunday slots end at 4 pm.

title: QuickShip to stop all weekend deliveries!
text: Insiders say QuickShip will stop weekend deliveries soon.

title: How to track a QuickShip parcel
text: Type your order number on the tracking page and click Track.
